stages.label: Tests
stages.about: A test author writes failing tests and locks them.

stages.label: Implement
stages.about: An implementer makes the locked tests pass.

stages.label: Static gate
stages.about: Format, lint, types and tests must all pass.

stages.label: Review
stages.about: A read-only reviewer checks the diff against the rubrics.

stages.label: Fix
stages.about: Findings from review go back to an implementer.

stages.label: Verify
stages.about: A verifier runs the change for real and reports what it saw.

stages.label: Cross-model
stages.about: A second model reviews the same diff.

stages.label: Human review
stages.about: The chunk waits for you to read the diff and accept or edit it.

stages.label: Final pass
stages.about: One last review of the whole tree after every chunk.
